==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Checklist|
*Begin the quest by talking to [[Chancellor Hassan]], who is in the southern room on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of [[Al Kharid palace]]. {{Chat option|1Is there anything I can help you with?}} Grab the jug of water off the table in the eastern room if you did not bring your own.
*Talk to [[Osman]] just north of the palace. {{Chat option|1What is the first thing I must do?|2What is the second thing you need?|3Okay, I better find some things.}}
}}

===Obtaining a disguise===
{{Needed|3 [[balls of wool]], [[ashes]], [[pot of flour]], [[Bucket of water]], [[yellow dye]] (or 2 onions and coins), and [[redberries]]}}
{{Checklist|*Go to [[Ned]]'s house with 3 [[ball of wool]] (just west of Leela in Draynor Village) and obtain the [[wig]] from him. {{Chat option|1Could you make other things apart from rope?|2How about some sort of wig?|1I have them here. Please make me a wig.}} if [[Dragon Slayer I]] is not started or {{Chat option|2Could you make other things apart from rope?|2How about some sort of wig?|1I have them here. Please make me a wig.}} if Dragon Slayer I is completed or started.
**You may buy a rope from Ned for 15 coins through dialogue, or 18 coins from his shop if you do not already have one.
*Go to [[Aggie]]'s house (just west of Ned's house)
**If needed, use the 2 onions on Aggie to get [[yellow dye]].
*Talk to her to get the [[skin paste]] (ash, pot of flour, bucket of water and redberries). {{Chat option|3 Can you make skin paste?|1Yes please. Mix me some skin paste.}}
*Use the yellow dye on the wig.
}}

===Obtaining a key===
{{Needed|[[soft clay]], and a [[bronze bar]]}}
{{Checklist|
*Go to the jailhouse east of Draynor Village (big red exclamation mark east of [[Draynor bank]]).
*Talk to [[Lady Keli]]. {{Chat option|1Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!|1What is your latest plan then?|2How do you know someone won't try to free him?|1Could I see the key please?|1Could I touch the key for a moment please?}}
*Take the [[key print]] and [[bronze bar]] to any [[furnace]] to smelt the [[Bronze key (Prince Ali Rescue|bronze key]]. 
**The closest is in [[Lumbridge]]. [[Members]] may use a [[Amulet of glory]] to teleport to the [[Edgeville furnace]], and then to teleport to [[Draynor Village]] for the next section.
*Talk to [[Leela]] south of the wheat fields in [[Draynor Village]] and talk to her. She will ask you to find the guard's weakness.
}}

===Breaking out===
{{Needed|3 [[beer]]s, [[rope]], [[Bronze key (Prince Ali Rescue)|bronze key]], [[wig]], [[paste]], and a [[pink skirt]]}}
{{Checklist|
*Go to the jailhouse.
*Talk to [[Joe (jail)|Joe]] and offer him the 3 drinks. {{Chat option|1I have some beer here, fancy one?}}
*Use the rope on [[Lady Keli]].
*Open the prison door with the key.
*Talk to [[Prince Ali]]. He will take the wig, skin paste, and pink skirt.
*Report back to [[Chancellor Hassan]].
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
